# QuotaPin 1.0.3

QuotaPin now has one stable release for Windows and macOS.

- **Windows:** run `QuotaPin-1.0.3.exe` for guided per-user setup.
- **macOS:** open `QuotaPin-macOS-1.0.3.dmg`, then double-click **QuotaPin Installer**. The universal image contains native Apple silicon and Intel builds.
- **Terminal installs:** the moving Windows and macOS Quick Start commands both resolve the latest immutable stable release, verify its GitHub digest, and install the same payload as the graphical package.
- **Mac release gate:** the exact final DMG is lifecycle-tested under macOS 15 and macOS 26 on native arm64 and x86_64 runners before publication.
- **Cleaner Windows tray:** settings now have one route—the QuotaPin panel inside Codex—so the tray no longer exposes a second settings bridge.

Installation and updates never close or relaunch an active Codex session. If safe attachment is unavailable, QuotaPin waits for the next normal Codex launch.

Windows Quick Start (x64 Windows 10 version 2004 or later):

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS Quick Start:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash
```

The macOS package is currently ad-hoc signed and CI-validated, not Developer ID notarized. Real signed-in Codex and Gatekeeper reports are welcome through the macOS compatibility form.
